summary: Backend testing for NaijaInvest Nigerian investment platform. Wrote 21 pytest tests covering auth (admin login, register+welcome bonus, phone normalization, referral linking, bearer auth), products CRUD, investment flow with 3-gen referral commissions, withdrawal/coupon gating on has_invested, deposits/withdrawals admin approve/reject, admin add-balance, coupons lifecycle, payment accounts visibility, settings, referrals endpoint shape, and admin stats. All 21 tests passing after fixing one critical bug.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error - clean() helper only stringified _id but left other ObjectId fields (referred_by, user_id, product_id) as raw ObjectId; FastAPI JSON encoder failed with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. FIXED by extending clean() to stringify ObjectId values in all fields (including list items).

minor.issue: Router health route is at '/api/' but returns 404. Only cosmetic - primary /api routes work.
No GET handler for admin products list (returns 405). Admin uses public /api/products (which shows all when role==admin) so functional but inconsistent with typical admin CRUD REST design.

action_items: Optional: add GET /api/admin/products list endpoint for symmetry
Consider centralizing ObjectId serialization (e.g., custom JSON encoder) so future endpoints don't repeat the same issue
critical_code_review_comments: clean() function was fragile: any endpoint returning a doc with ObjectId fields (referred_by, user_id, product_id) would 500. Now patched to stringify all ObjectId values in top-level and list values, but nested dicts are still not covered.
CORS: allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL from env with fallback to localhost:3000; explicit origins with allow_credentials=True is correct.
Auth uses httpOnly + secure + SameSite=none cookies; Bearer fallback also implemented; both verified working.
process_profit_drops runs lazily on /auth/me and /investments — this is fine but relies on read traffic; if user never opens app they miss drops until they do. Design choice, not a bug.
referral commission uses wallet_balance (not bonus_balance) so referrer earns real money — matches spec.
withdrawal hold: funds deducted from wallet_balance on request and refunded on reject — correct.
seed_admin updates password if changed on startup — good.
server.py is 971 lines - consider splitting into routers/ subpackage as it grows.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed clean() to stringify all ObjectId fields)
test_credentials: Admin phone=+2348000000000 password=Admin@12345 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users created dynamically with TEST_ prefixed names and random +23480XXXXXXXX phones.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed users, products, coupons, payment accounts; not cleaned up but namespaced (TEST_/COUP prefixes). Admin/base 3 seeded products remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is stable and passes 21/21 via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. Uses pytest-xdist loadscope; user_b session fixture pre-invests so gated flows work regardless of which worker runs which class. If new referral gen2/gen3 tests are needed, chain user_c referred_by user_b and admin-credit + invest to verify gen2 5% and gen3 2% commissions arrive on user_b and user_a respectively.
rca of the issue: Only critical bug: clean() dropped `_id`->`id` but left other ObjectId fields (referred_by, user_id, product_id) as bson.ObjectId. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder can't serialize ObjectId → raised ValueError → 500. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with a valid referral_code, or POST /api/deposits. Fix applied: extended clean() to convert all ObjectId values (scalars and list items) to str before returning.
